title: The Magic Tiffin Box | Say Thank You Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful kids song about a magic tiffin box that only shares its snacks when we remember to say thank you.
It teaches little ones that good manners bring happy surprises for everyone.
Sing along with the catchy chorus and learn to say thank you!

Open, open, the box has a face
Smiling and grinning, such a cute grace
Tick tick tock, the lid goes pop!
The magic box says "Hello, hi!"

Say thank you, ting ting, say thank you, ting ting
Magic snacks come out
Ding ding ding ding
Yum yum, thank you, ding!

Big brother grabs a snack, quick quick quick
Munch munch munch, so fast, so quick
No thank you, no thank you, oops!
The box makes a frown, frown, frown

Say thank you, ting ting, say thank you, ting ting
Magic snacks come out
Ding ding ding ding
Yum yum, thank you, ding!

Clack clack, the box shuts tight
No thank you, no snacks tonight
Shh shh shh, the lid is closed
Say sorry, then the box says yes!

Say thank you, ting ting, say thank you, ting ting
Magic snacks come out
Ding ding ding ding
Yum yum, thank you, ding!

Amma calls, "Come, sweets for all!"
Ting ting, the box says "Yay!"
Thank you, thank you, thank you all
Sweet, sweet, sweets, hooray, hooray!
